text:
The throughput review (THROUGHPUT_PROMPT and its brief in crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs) sees only THROUGHPUT.md and design/. It never sees its earlier design requests or how they ended. What I read: 10 of the 11 November reviews in records/throughput-reviews/2026-11 name 'landing and rebuild'. Their expected_minutes_saved swings between 1830, 5.0, 7.0 and 5.0. The last six design jobs were all rejected, and verifiers found that the prediction does not fit the measured figures (kxrd, r796, ggxj, 5har). Change the review so that: (1) its workspace includes the earlier design requests with their outcomes and the verifier's major findings; (2) Athena refuses a review answer whose expected_minutes_saved is above the stage's measured minutes, and the prompt asks for the saving to be worked out from the THROUGHPUT.md stage figures it cites; (3) when the last design request for the same stage was rejected, the new request names that job and its findings. Add tests for (2) and (3), and a CHANGELOG.md entry.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: Each throughput review names the same stage again, with a prediction that is not checked against the measured figures, and every design job it files is rejected
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs, THROUGHPUT.md, design/., records/throughput-reviews/2026-11, CHANGELOG.md
